{{Quote|Lord Krayt's Dragons -- you'd best withdraw your fleet and troops, Admiral Veed.|[[Darth Stryfe]]|<ref name="LW4" />}}
A '''Dragon ship''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that served in the [[One Sith]]. Manufactured in secret alongside [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator''-class starfighters]], these ships were unveiled in [[138 ABY]], when the deposed Krayt returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to reclaim his throne from his "most trusted" servant.

==History==
[[File:Dragonshipscoruscant.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Dragon ships silhouetted against [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscants]] sky.]]
Krayt used several of these [[Starship/Legends|ships]] to travel to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], bringing along [[Darth Talon]], [[Darth Nihl]] and a host of [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]]. The ships orbited the world while Krayt traveled to the surface, where he [[Assault on the Temple of the Sith|toppled]] the reign of his usurper, [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him in battle.<ref name="LW1" />

Months after the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] had reclaimed his throne, Krayt's Dragons were unleashed during the Sith [[attack on the Hidden Temple]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Like the Annihilators, the Dragons cut through both [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Sith Imperial]] and enemy ships.<ref name="LW4" />

[[File:Alliance_vs_dragon_ship.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Dragon ship firing on the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|Alliance]] over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]
Dragon ships were also deployed during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[138 ABY]]. After the conclusion of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], these ships were ordered hidden by [[Darth Nihl]] as part of his plans for the future of the [[One Sith]].<ref name="LW6" />
